# TraceVault AI — Instructions

> This file provides additional Copilot context for the workspace.

## Quick reference

### Package naming
All internal packages use the `@tracevault/` scope:
- `@tracevault/event-schema`
- `@tracevault/common`
- `@tracevault/replay-engine`
- `@tracevault/sdk-typescript`
- `@tracevault/graph-model`
- `@tracevault/redaction`
- `@tracevault/connectors-core`
- `@tracevault/ui`

### Event types
The canonical event types are:
`run.start`, `run.end`, `run.error`, `prompt.input`, `prompt.output`, `context.retrieved`, `context.injected`, `tool.call.start`, `tool.call.end`, `tool.call.error`, `approval.requested`, `approval.granted`, `approval.denied`, `side_effect.executed`, `side_effect.failed`, `model.request`, `model.response`, `policy.evaluated`, `policy.violated`, `annotation`, `custom`

### API patterns
- REST endpoints under `/v1/`
- Response envelope: `{ data, meta, errors }`
- Cursor-based pagination
- Zod validation on request bodies
- Typed error responses with machine-readable codes

### Test patterns
- Vitest for all tests
- Fixture files in `tests/fixtures/`
- Co-located unit tests: `*.test.ts`
- Integration tests in `tests/integration/`
- Use deterministic IDs and timestamps in fixtures

### Database patterns
- PostgreSQL with parameterized queries
- `snake_case` table and column names
- UUID v7 for IDs (time-sortable)
- UTC timestamps as `timestamptz`
- Append-only for events, mutable for run metadata
